metadata.labelSource: Source-inspected pilot labels; not independently reviewed benchmark ground truth.
metadata.scope: Function retrieval pilot over existing Java and TypeScript snapshots. Required evidence is the complete annotated implementation. Index construction and generation are excluded.
metadata.ablation: without-dependencies returns no graph neighbors; candidate recall and context compiler are unchanged.
metadata.cache: Warm embedding and database caches after one excluded pass per task; serial HTTP queries; rotated configuration order.
metadata.metric: Recall@10 is single-label Hit@10; taskSuccess denotes retrieval with required source coverage, not successful code generation.
